agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/aligned_indent.py: AlignedIndentFilter.nl() had an inverted isinstance check (`isinstance(offset, int)` instead of `isinstance(offset, str)`), causing a TypeError whenever nl() was called with a string keyword argument (e.g., nl('SELECT'), nl(token_indent)). This broke all reindent_aligned formatting paths (basic SELECT, JOINs, CASE statements, subqueries, identifier lists, etc.), matching the 7 reported failing checks. Corrected the isinstance check to target str, restoring correct aligned-reindent formatting. Verified manually with several representative queries (basic select/where, joins, case statements) producing correctly aligned output with no errors.
